results.evidence: Owner said 'do what you recommend'. The row describes the Eye Col line; its own overview gives 5.10a to the separate East Arete, so 5.10a is the other line's grade. The only grading of the Eye Col line is 5.7 (h1.json).

ops.expect: The 'South Route' (III, 5.7) grade/line is not independently confirmed against a named guidebook topo; published sources instead document a much harder East Arête (II 5.10a, 2003 enchainment) and North Buttress (5.9, 2022) on this peak - verify beta before relying on 5.7 as the crux.
ops.value: The 5.7 grade for the Eye Col line rests on a single party's account; the harder grades published for this peak belong to the East Arête (5.10a) and North Buttress (5.9), not to this line.

ops.expect: Top-level grade field previously read "Grade III, 5.7", self-contradicting this row own rock_grade (5.10a) and its own beta text, which quotes the FA account directly: "It is graded II 5.10a." No independently-documented, distinctly-named 5.7 "South Route" was found separate from this line. Fixed grade to "Grade II, 5.10a" to match the row own corroborated sub-fields. Resolved 2026-07-28.
ops.value: Grade set to 5.7: the 5.10a grade belongs to the East Arête, a different line reached along the crest from the east. The one account of the climb from the Eye Col grades its crux hand crack 5.7.
